name: Airtable
description: Airtable is a connected apps platform that enables teams to modernize their business processes. The company’s low-code tools are used by more than 250,000 organizations globally, including 80% of Fortune 100 companies, to power critical departmental workflows including planning product releases, managing global marketing campaigns, and supporting the entire back office of an organization.

name: Alchemy
description: Alchemy is a Web3 development platform enabling users to build and operate decentralized applications on blockchains with reliability, data accuracy, speed, and scalability.

name: Alibaba Group
description: Alibaba Group is China’s leading e-commerce company, providing technology infrastructure that enables businesses to transform the way they market, sell, operate and improve their efficiencies. Alibaba’s businesses comprise commerce, cloud computing, digital media and entertainment, and innovation initiatives, including: Alibaba.com (#1 global B2B e-commerce platform), Taobao Marketplace (#1 China C2C e-commerce platform), and Taobao Mall (‘T-Mall,’ #1 China B2C e-commerce platform). Alibaba’s IPO in 2014 was the largest in history.

name: Allyes
description: Allyes is a leading interactive marketing solutions provider in China with the following online business segments: ad agency, ad networks, advertising technology solutions, and Internet-related market research.

name: Altera
description: Altera is a leading fabless semiconductor company providing high-performance programmable logic devices for mission-critical applications across end markets.

name: AMC
description: AMC Entertainment is the world’s largest movie exhibition company with approximately 1,000 theatres and 11,000 screens around the globe and nearly a century of history. The company also leads the industry in innovation, leveraging technology, on-site enhancements, and business model innovations to provide the best moviegoing experience for consumers.

name: Ancestry
description: Ancestry is the largest provider of family history and personal DNA testing, harnessing the information found in family trees, historical records, and genetics to help people gain a new level of understanding about their lives.

name: Ant Group
description: Ant Group is China’s leading fintech platform company, with businesses spanning across payment processing, consumer and SME lending, wealth management, insurance, credit rating, and other financial technology services.

name: Aras
description: Aras provides product lifecycle management software solutions to the world’s leading manufacturers of complex, connected products. Aras’ product lifecycle management platform and applications connect users in all disciplines and functions to critical product information and processes across the extended enterprise.

name: Australian Professional Leagues
description: APL is a digital sports entertainment business that holds the exclusive and perpetual right to operate, market, and commercialize the top-tier professional domestic football competitions in Australia. Known collectively as the A-Leagues, they are made up of A-League Men, A-League Women, A-League Youth, and the E-League.

name: Avago
description: Avago Technologies, now Broadcom, is a leading designer, developer, and global supplier of a broad range of analog and digital semiconductor connectivity solutions serving the wired infrastructure, wireless communications, enterprise storage, and industrial end-markets.

name: Avaya
description: Avaya is a global leader in enterprise communications systems. The Company provides unified communications, contact centers, data solutions, and related services directly and through its channel partners to leading businesses and organizations around the world.

name: AVI-SPL
description: AVI-SPL is a leader in the video conferencing and audio visual industry. The Company provides system integration and managed services for professional video conferencing and AV installations in the corporate, education, performance venue, and government sectors in over 20 countries.

name: Blackhawk Network
description: Blackhawk Network is a global financial technology company and a leader in prepaid gift, reward and incentive technologies and solutions. Blackhawk’s prepaid payments network connects more than 1,000 brands to over 244,000 retail distribution locations and online channels.

name: BlackLine
description: BlackLine is a leading provider of enterprise-class solutions to automate and control mission-critical financial close processes.

name: Blue Danube System
description: Blue Danube Systems is a provider of wireless antenna technology. The company’s High Definition Active Antenna System (HDAAS) is a low-cost solution that can be integrated into the current wireless infrastructure through a simple retrofit. HDAAS delivers significant increases in wireless capacity to wireless operators.

name: Broadcom
description: Broadcom, formerly Avago Technologies, is a leading designer, developer, and global supplier of a broad range of analog and digital semiconductor connectivity solutions serving the wired infrastructure, wireless communications, enterprise storage, and industrial end-markets.

name: Byju’s
description: Byju’s is a pioneer and the leading player in India’s online EdTech industry. It offers interactive learning modules for pre-K and K-12 students, and online test preparation classes for undergraduate and postgraduate exams. The company has also expanded into international markets through its unique offerings and partnerships with leading global content providers.

name: Carbon
description: Carbon3D is a 3D printing company working at the intersection of hardware, software and molecular science. Its Continuous Liquid Interface Production technology (CLIP) harnesses light and oxygen to grow commercial quality parts 25-100X faster than conventional 3D printing.

name: Caris Life Sciences
description: Caris Life Sciences is a leading provider of AI-enabled molecular diagnostics services. The company offers a suite of molecular profiling offerings assessing DNA, RNA, and proteins to reveal a molecular blueprint that helps physicians and cancer patients make more precise and personalized treatment decisions.

name: Carta
description: Carta is a leading cap table management software and equity administration platform with a mission to create “more owners” by facilitating simple and transparent equity issuance and therefore increased employee ownership. The company’s cap table and investor reporting products serve as the system of record for equity ownership across private markets, and its CartaX platform enables companies to offer their shareholders access to efficient and transparent auction-based liquidity.

name: Casago (formerly Vacasa)
description: Casago (formerly Vacasa) is the largest vacation rental platform in North America. The Company’s integrated technology and services platform provides an end-to-end management solution to vacation homeowners, including dynamic pricing, multi-channel distribution, and optimization of maintenance services.

name: Cast & Crew
description: Cast & Crew grew as a premier provider of technology-enabled payroll, production accounting and related value-added services to the entertainment industry. The Company helped content creators manage the complexities of entertainment industry payroll processing; residuals processing; tax incentives and financial services; regulatory compliance; and production accounting. It was acquired by EQT.

name: CDW
description: CDW is the leading direct marketer of multi-branded information technology products and services to business, government, education and healthcare customers. The Company markets Dell, HP, and Cisco branded products, among others, worldwide.

name: Cegid
description: Cegid is a European leader in enterprise management software and cloud services, offering a suite of SaaS solutions to its customers in France, Iberia, and globally. In addition to finance, tax, and human resources, the company also provides industry-specific cloud solutions for retailers, accountants, manufacturers, and other service-sector professionals.

name: Celonis
description: Celonis is a global leader in process mining and enterprise automation software, enabling companies to generate “x-rays” of their business processes to identify inefficiencies and enable optimization.

name: City Football Group
description: City Football Group is the world’s leading soccer platform, encompassing both marquee clubs in established markets and a global footprint across attractive long-term growth geographies.

name: Clari/Salesloft
description: Clari/Salesloft is a leading provider of an end-to-end revenue platform that combines revenue operations, sales engagement, and conversation intelligence to enable real-time forecasting, pipeline visibility, and optimized go-to-market execution.

name: Con-Pearl
description: Con-pearl is a leading manufacturer and marketer of recycled plastic products with a focus on the automotive and packaging sectors. The Company supplies lightweight, recyclable, and environmentally-friendly plastic solutions to a variety of industries with an innovative and proprietary product portfolio.

name: Convenience Bee
description: Convenience Bee is a leading homegrown tech-enabled consumer retail platform in China, operating a large network of convenience stores across the country.

name: Cornerstone
description: Cornerstone OnDemand is a global leader in cloud-based learning and human capital management software. The company solutions help organizations to realize the potential of the modern workforce. It was acquired by Clearlake Capital.

name: Credit Karma
description: Credit Karma offers its members digital tools for monitoring and improving credit health through the company’s personal financial technology platform. The company also leverages advanced data modeling to provide a full suite of personalized financial product recommendations. Credit Karma was acquired by Intuit.

name: Crystal Decisions / Business Objects
description: Crystal Decisions, formerly known as Seagate Software Information Management Group, grew as a business intelligence company known for its flagship product, Crystal Reports, one of the most widely used report creation products available at the time. Crystal Decisions was acquired by Business Objects, an enterprise software company with a similar focus on business intelligence, in 2003, and Business Objects was later acquired by SAP.

name: Ctrip
description: Ctrip, now Trip.com, is a leading multinational provider of accommodation reservations, transportation ticketing, packaged tours, and corporate travel management. It was the largest online consolidator of accommodations and transportation tickets in China in terms of transaction volume.

name: Datek Online / Ameritrade
description: Datek Online grew as an internet broker before being acquired by Ameritrade in 2002. In 2006, Ameritrade became TD Ameritrade and has since remained an online brokerage firm.

name: Dell Technologies
description: Dell Technologies is a leading provider of end-to-end IT solutions, including data center infrastructure and software, end-user computing devices, cloud solutions and security solutions. The company serves customers ranging from the world’s largest businesses to individual consumers.

name: Diamond Baseball Holdings
description: Diamond Baseball Holdings (DBH) owns and operates select Minor League Baseball Clubs affiliated with Major League Baseball. DBH seeks to support, promote and enhance its clubs through professional management, best practices, innovation and investment, with the mission to elevate fan and player experiences and enrich communities across the country.

name: Didi Chuxing
description: Didi is China’s leading one-stop mobile transportation platform. The company offers a broad range of transportation options through a smartphone application, including e-hailing of privately owned vehicles, taxis, and black cars and long-distance ride-sharing, across over 400 cities in China.

name: eConnections
description: eConnections made its mark as an Internet-based supply-chain management services company for the electronics industry.

name: Eka
description: Eka is a leading international provider of commodity trading and risk management software, covering trading and position management, physical supply chain, enterprise risk management and compliance and analytics.

name: Electronic Arts
description: Electronic Arts is a global leader in digital interactive entertainment. The company is focused on building games and experiences that grow the global online communities around its key franchises and intellectual property, while deepening engagement through innovation and interactive storytelling.

name: Endeavor Group Holdings
description: Endeavor Group Holdings is the parent company of WME Group, which comprises category leaders representing talent, intellectual property and brands. It also holds a controlling ownership stake in TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), one of the largest publicly traded sports and entertainment companies, fueled by businesses including UFC and WWE.

name: Enterasys
description: Enterasys Networks, Inc. is an American networking company, providing networking equipment ranging from routers, switches, and IEEE 802.11 wireless access points and controllers. It was acquired by Extreme Networks.

name: Entrata
description: Entrata is a leading property management software platform that offers a suite of solutions spanning the full resident lifecycle, helping property managers and owners with marketing, leasing, resident services, and core property management.

name: Equinox Group
description: Equinox Group is a high-growth collective of the world’s most influential lifestyle brands, that are disruptive leaders in the convergence of fitness, experiences and community, including Equinox, SoulCycle, Blink Fitness, and others.

name: EverCommerce
description: EverCommerce is a leading provider of business management software, marketing and payments technology for small and medium-sized businesses in the services sector.

name: Exact
description: Exact is a market-leading provider of business application software, and serving accountants and businesses in Benelux with high value-add solutions in the cloud. The company’s integrated software suite includes accounting, tax, logistics, CRM, HR, and payroll.

name: Expedia Group
description: Expedia Group is a leading global travel e-commerce platform with an extensive portfolio of well-recognized brands, providing a wide range of travel products for leisure and business travelers.

name: Facile.it
description: Facile.it is the leading Italian tech-enabled broker that provides millions of customers access every month to a product offering across insurance and financial products through its omnichannel distribution network of stores and agents.

name: Fanatics Collectibles
description: Fanatics Collectibles is a direct-to-consumer platform and licensee of sports and entertainment trading cards and collectibles, including for some of the world’s leading sports leagues and players associations.

name: Fanatics, Inc.
description: Fanatics is a leading global digital sports and eCommerce platform, with offerings including officially licensed sports merchandise, trading cards and collectibles, and digital collectibles and NFTs.

name: FATHOM
description: FATHOM became the leading provider of integrated utility-to-utility, cloud-based data and customer service solutions for water utilities, bringing heightened efficiencies to water utilities and their customers.

name: First Advantage
description: First Advantage is a global software and data company that provides comprehensive, end-to-end identity solutions, criminal background screening, credential verifications, drug and health screening, and continuous risk monitoring. Combining AI-powered proprietary technology platforms with proprietary data, primary source data, and third-party data, First Advantage helps organizations hire with confidence and manage risk across the entire employee lifecycle.

name: Flextronics
description: Flextronics is a global electronics manufacturer that delivers technology innovation, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions to various industries and end markets. In 2015, the company rebranded from Flextronics to Flex.

name: Flix
description: Flix is an asset-light travel technology platform to enable high-quality and cost-efficient intercity bus and train travel across Europe and the U.S. by partnering with independent bus and train operators and using proprietary data analytics.

name: ForeFlight
description: ForeFlight is a leading provider of digital flight planning and navigation software. The company’s products help pilots and flight departments plan flights, increase flight safety and efficiency and are widely used across personal, corporate, air transport, and government operations.

name: G42

name: Gartner

name: Genies
description: Genies is a leading Web3-enabled digital avatar ecosystem company with a vision to empower authentic digital identity in the metaverse.

name: Gerson Lehrman Group
description: Gerson Lehrman Group grew to manage the world’s leading network of experts and provide technology and services to support a marketplace for expertise, helping the world’s leading financial services firms, consultancies, corporations, and nonprofit organizations find, engage, and manage experts for information in a broad range of industries and disciplines.

name: Getir
description: Getir is a leading tech-enabled, on-demand retail logistics provider. The company is a pioneer in the “ultrafast” delivery category having revolutionized last-mile delivery with its 10-minute grocery delivery proposition in 2015. Getir delivers a selection of 1,500 everyday items to wherever its customers wish within minutes, 7 days a week, day and night.

name: Global Blue

name: Global Payments
description: Global Payments is a leading payments technology company delivering innovative software and services to over four million merchant locations across 170 countries.

name: GoDaddy
description: Go Daddy is a leading provider of cloud-based software and services that enable, empower, and improve the online presence of small-and-medium-sized businesses. Go Daddy offers domain registration, web hosting, and related value-added services.

name: GoodRx

name: Groupe Meilleurtaux
description: Groupe Meilleurtaux is a leading omnichannel insurance broker in France, Belgium and Luxembourg, offering a broad and diversified range of brokerage and distribution services for credit, insurance and savings & investment products.

name: Groupon
description: Groupon, a leading social commerce site, offers deals on local products and services in hundreds of markets around the world.

name: Grupo BC
description: Grupo BC is the leading tech-enabled processing platform and software provider for mortgage management, legal solutions and digitally-enabled services to financial institutions in Iberia and Latin America.

name: Hillstone Networks
description: Hillstone Networks is a provider of network security equipment (firewall and Unified Threat Management products) to carriers, data centers, enterprises, and SMBs in China.

name: Hyla Mobile
description: HYLA Mobile (formerly eRecyclingCorps) is one of the world’s leading providers of mobile device trade-in and reuse solutions. HYLA Mobile was acquired by Assurant.

name: i2
description: i2, acquired by IBM, grew as a leading provider of technology solutions enabling its law enforcement, military, homeland security, intelligence and other government agency customers to use advanced analysis and visualization technology to monitor, manage and solve investigations more effectively.

name: Imagine Learning
description: Imagine Learning is a leading digital education platform that develops digital curricula and tools for millions of primary and secondary school students across the United States.

name: Instinet
description: Instinet, a pioneer in electronic trading, was acquired by the Nasdaq Stock Market and is now part of Nomura Group.

name: Integrity Marketing Group
description: Integrity Marketing Group is a leading, tech-enabled distributor of health insurance, life insurance and wealth solutions focused on the Senior Market.

name: Intelsat
description: Intelsat is the world’s largest provider of fixed satellite services, delivering advanced transmission access for information and entertainment to some of the world’s leading media and network companies, multinational corporations, Internet service providers, and governmental agencies.

name: Interactive Data Corporation
description: Interactive Data Corporation became a leader in the financial information services industry by supplying pricing and reference data to the back offices of financial institutions around the world and enabling clients to complete mission critical functions such as portfolio valuation, regulatory compliance, and risk management while also serving clients’ needs in electronic trading, wealth management, real time market data, and fixed income analytics.

name: IonQ
description: IonQ is a leader in trapped ion quantum computing. The company is building hardware and software that leverage quantum physics to use information in a fundamentally different way from classical computing, allowing customers to tackle problems unsolvable by current technology, including fundamental problems relating to how to live sustainably on our planet, cure diseases, and efficiently move people and goods.

name: IPC
description: IPC is a leading provider of mission-critical communications solutions primarily to the financial services industry. The Company’s Trading Systems and Network Services solutions differentiate IPC as one of the few integrated providers of trading systems, maintenance, and communications services.

name: Island / Instinet Group
description: Instinet is an institutional, agency-model broker that executes trades for asset management firms, hedge funds, insurance companies, mutual funds, and pension funds. The company offers sales trading services and trading technologies, including algorithms, trade cost analysis, commission management, and independent research.

name: Iterable
description: Iterable is a leading omnichannel customer engagement platform that helps brands connect to their customers in real-time via hyper-personalized communications across email, web, mobile, social, and other channels.

name: IVC Evidensia
description: IVC Evidensia is the world’s largest independent veterinary services company, with market-leading positions in Europe and Canada, an extensive network of clinics/hospitals, and comprehensive pet e-commerce and telemedicine offerings.

name: Jio Platforms
description: Jio is the #1 broadband connectivity provider in India and also delivers an ecosystem of leading digital services applications on a single platform.

name: Khazna Data Centers
description: Khazna Data Centers is the largest hyperscale wholesale data center provider in the Middle East and North Africa.

name: Klarna
description: Klarna is a leading online shopping platform and largest global provider of “buy now, pay later” services. The company has a global reach, connecting its merchant partners to millions of consumers via integrated e-commerce check-out solutions and Klarna’s proprietary mobile app.

name: Koubei
description: Koubei provides mobile solutions for brick-and-mortar businesses to capture growing consumption in China. It allows users to look for local merchants, place orders, conduct payments and write reviews from directly within the Alipay app. Koubei was established in 2015 by Alibaba Group and Ant Financial Services Group, and has since merged with Ele.me.

description: 东方鸿鹄融合了互联网领先者字节跳动的线上数字能力，与饮料龙头企业王老吉的线下渠道能力，致力于数字化的方式重构线下全链路交易场景。公司已经沉淀了完善的产品设计能力，形成了有效科学的产品研发方法论，高效助力未来新品类扩张，并成功打造数字化营销底层能力平台，通过数字化能力革新传统线下渠道，实现了品牌、消费者、经销商、终端销售渠道的数字换闭环，真正做到了全链路的可视可控。

name: 中海储能
description: 中海储能科技（北京）有限公司（简称中海储能）是一家为新能源建设提供储能解决方案的科技型企业，专注于新型大容量电化学储能产品——铁铬液流电池储能系统的研究开发，集研发、生产、制造与商业化应用为一体，是国内铁铬液流电池技术的先行者和集大成者。

name: 乐动机器人
description: 2017年成立的国家高新技术企业，专注于机器人移动感知技术自主研发和生产制造，拥有300+项知识产权，覆盖环境感知、自主导航及AI算法。产品应用于清洁、商用服务机器人领域，服务全球上百家企业，获中国高价值专利奖及深圳高层次人才计划支持。

name: 云鲸智能
description: 云鲸创立于2016年，是一家立足家用机器人领域、致力于研发革命性科技产品的公司。作为一家机器人创新企业，云鲸横跨了SLAM、三维感知、AI物体识别、机器人结构技术、大数据应用等多个领域，目前已在多个方向取得突破，已累计申请了超1100篇技术专利。2019年双十一，云鲸凭借独创的“拖布自清洁”功能引爆消费市场.2023年，云鲸开启多领域布局，进军智能洗地机领域。2024年，云鲸多品齐发，完成多价格段布局，并加速拓展线下渠道，门店分布成都、重庆、武汉、广州、苏州等多个城市。

name: 众能联合
description: 众能联合数字技术有限公司成立于2016年，总部位于南京，是一家专注于工程机械设备租赁及数字化管理服务的企业。公司通过平台化运营模式，为客户提供高空作业设备、挖掘机械等多种工程设备的灵活租赁服务，提升行业效率与服务质量。

name: 健海科技
description: 健海科技是一家专注于智慧医疗与健康管理的科技企业，成立于2015年，总部位于杭州。公司以“让健康管理更智能”为核心理念，提供基于AI的慢病管理平台、患者随访系统、智能问诊工具等解决方案，助力医疗机构实现数字化转型。

name: 元保
description: 元保数科是一家专注于保险科技与数字健康服务的企业，成立于2018年，总部位于北京。公司通过大数据、AI等技术手段优化保险产品设计与风险控制，同时整合健康管理资源，为用户提供个性化保险+健康服务方案。

name: 兰
description: LAN（兰）是中国纯净功效护肤品牌，2012年由丁小兰创立，所属公司为杭州兰禧化妆品有限公司，总部位于浙江省杭州市。 品牌以“生命如蘭 美丽如常”为口号，坚持“精净、高能”的纯净护肤定位，首倡Clean Beauty理念，主打“以油养肤”产品线，代表性产品包括水感卸妆油、臻米糯感洁颜油等。

name: 凌空天行
description: 凌空天行是国内从事高超音速飞行技术与应用服务的商业航天企业，具有全系统覆盖的高超音速飞行器总体设计能力。

name: 剂泰医药
description: 剂泰医药成立于2019年，总部位于深圳，是以人工智能（AI）驱动、利用精准靶向的药物递送和药物发现技术，为患者开发更有效的治疗药物的创新型生物技术公司。

name: 加速进化
description: 加速进化成立于 2023 年，是一家聚焦具身智能与人形机器人研发的科技公司。创始团队有清华大学机器人、自动化领域背景，产品定位在科研、教育以及未来家庭生活场景。公司致力于自主设计机器人本体、运控操作系统、开发者工具（SDK）等软硬件平台。

name: 卧安机器人
description: 卧安机器人（SwitchBot）隶属于卧安机器人（深圳）股份有限公司，是全球领先的AI具身家庭机器人系统提供商，致力于构建以智能家庭机器人为核心的智能家庭生态系统。公司以机器人定位与环境构建技术、AI机器视觉控制技术、分布式神经控制网络技术三大核心技术为底座，以智慧家庭全场景覆盖的产品矩阵为载体，持续推动AI具身智能技术在家庭场景的应用落地。

name: 厨芯智能
description: 厨芯科技，致力于成为全球领先的餐饮设备和服务提供商。从商厨清洁领域着手，提供餐饮后厨“一站式服务”解决方案，驱动餐饮行业的智能化和数字化升级。厨芯业务范围现已覆盖全国超200座城市。通过部署在客户现场的自研物联网设备，结合云端数据调控，智能服务调度，帮助餐厅高效快速实现餐具清洁及菜品出品，并以自建运营网络提供全方位优质服务，帮助餐厅降本增效，全面守护餐饮卫生安全。

name: 和生创新
description: 深圳和生创新（2020年成立）专注智能家电研发与销售，主打欧美线上市场。公司以用户需求驱动产品设计，结合物联网技术优化生活场景，主张以科技赋能家电产品，与全球家庭共享科技和创新的乐趣。

name: 塔斯汀
description: 塔斯汀品牌隶属于福州塔斯汀餐饮管理有限公司，是一个主营中国汉堡的餐饮连锁品牌，面向具备个性主张、独特审美、独立意识的年轻受众群体，全力打造符合国人口味的手擀现烤中国汉堡。

name: 壁仞科技
description: 壁仞科技研发高性能通用GPU，打造自主原创的高性能GPU软硬件体系，构建国产智能计算产业生态。首代壁仞科技通用GPU产品基于原创训推一体芯片架构，已在多地智算中心落地，壁仞科技实现中国首个四种及以上异构芯片混训技术落地，突破了算力孤岛难题。

name: 壹米滴答
description: 壹米滴答成立于 2015 年，是中国一家综合型物流 / 供应链服务公司，主营 B2B 零担运输 & 仓配业务，覆盖全国省、市、县/区网络。“滴答到门”、大票零担、小票快运、整车等多种物流产品。公司重视数据化 / AI /云计算/物联网等技术在物流网络规划与运输效率提升的应用。

name: 奇点能源
description: 奇点能源是一家专注于先进储能系统中核心装备技术研究和产品开发，致力于推动大规模清洁能源接入，为全球碳中和目标贡献解决方案的公司。

name: 奕信通
description: 北京奕信通科技有限公司，是一家技术领先的ICT液冷产品与解决方案提供商，集产研一体化、解决方案提供、液冷全寿命周期服务于一身的高科技制造企业。公司成立于2021年，总部位于北京，2023年获数千万人民币的A轮融资。公司自研冷板液冷和浸没液冷双技术路线，目前累计交付200MW液冷案例，项目遍布国内外，

name: 奕斯伟材料
description: 从事硅材料业务的奕斯伟材料公司是一家12英寸电子级硅单晶抛光片和外延片的提供商，产品广泛应用于电子通讯、新能源汽车等领域所需要的存储芯片、逻辑芯片、图像传感器、显示驱动芯片及功率器件等。

name: 孔辉科技
description: 国内首家实现乘用车空气悬架系统量产供货的企业，由中国工程院郭孔辉院士团队创立，总部位于湖州，拥有重庆、广州、武汉制造基地及苏州研发总院。核心产品包括电控悬架系统、空气弹簧总成等，获岚图、理想、比亚迪等16家车企40余车型定点，拥有百余项专利，获国家专精特新“小巨人”认证。

name: 字节跳动
description: 字节跳动以人工智能为核心技术驱动产品发展，成立于2012年3月，是最早将人工智能应用于移动互联网场景的科技企业之一。公司以建设"全球创作与交流平台"为愿景 。字节跳动的全球化布局始于2015年 ，"技术出海"是字节跳动全球化发展的核心战略 ，其旗下产品有今日头条、西瓜视频、抖音、皮皮虾、懂车帝、悟空问答等。

name: 宇树科技
description: 是国内研发、生产和销售消费级、行业级高性能四足机器人、灵巧六轴机械臂的新锐创企，也是全球最早一批实现四足机器人商业化的公司之一。被广泛应用在农业、工业领域，以及特定的安防巡检、勘测探索、公共救援、医疗防疫陪护等重磅行业中提供强有力支持。

name: 安世亚太
description: 安世亚太科技股份有限公司成立于2003年，是中国工业企业研发信息化领域的领先者，专注于PLM（产品生命周期管理）、虚拟仿真等技术领域，推动中国工业技术创新与发展。

name: 安仕新能源
description: 安仕新能源，深耕锂电产品，专注于锂离子和磷酸铁锂电池组的研发，在锂电池领域处于领军地位，特别是192V 磷酸铁锂高压UPS电池组领域，行业市场占有率处于第一位置。安仕新能源也上榜2020年深圳市第一批高新认定名单。

name: 小红岛
description: 小红岛（隶属于南京众岛电子商务有限公司），成立于 2019 年 9 月，是一家社区新零售服务商，主要面向年轻家庭，尤其是社区场景中对便利性与性价比有较高需求的消费群体。小红岛以“成本价运营”的模式为会员提供全天候折扣商品，整体价格约为市场零售价的 6-7 折；支持“1 小时送货上门”“门店自提”及“到店选购”等多种购物方式，且门槛低，多数南京地区门店通用。

name: 布鲁可
description: 布鲁可是中国积木原创品牌，隶属于布鲁可集团，致力于传递“拼的快乐”，拥有500多项专利，是国家知识产权优势企业。其产品线涵盖大颗粒积木、主题系列及教育类积木玩具，深受儿童喜爱。

name: 微脉
description: 微脉是一家数字健康公司，成立于2015年9月9日，首创AI+全病程管理，推动医疗健康服务的数智化升级，赋能医疗机构和医护人员，为全人群提供全方位、全周期的医疗健康服务，满足老百姓多层次、多样化、个性化的服务需求。

name: 德兰明海
description: 深圳市德兰明海新能源股份有限公司，成立于2013年，专注于用户侧储能产品和分布式储能解决方案，掌握国际先进的新能源储能技术及完整储能电池应用方案，在光伏储能一体化、离并网微电网系统等领域具有领先优势。

name: 恩和生物
description: Bota Bio（恩和生物）是一家合成生物学领域的创新企业，专注于通过人工智能驱动的生物工程平台进行新型蛋白质设计和生物制造，广泛应用于医药、食品、农业等领域。公司成立于2019年，总部位于杭州，并设有美国分部。

name: 悦刻
description: 悦刻是中国电子烟行业的领先品牌，由汪莹创立于2018年，专注于研发、生产和销售高品质电子烟产品。悦刻以其时尚设计、丰富口味和良好的用户体验迅速占领市场，成为国内电子烟消费市场的头部品牌之一。公司于2021年在美国纽交所上市（股票代码：RLX）。

name: 扬腾集团
description: 福建扬腾创新信息科技有限公司，始于2013年，总部位于福建省福州市，在深圳、德国汉堡、美国加州、香港等地设有全资子公司，是一家集设计、研发、销售为一体的综合型汽车零配件运营企业。

name: 擎朗智能
description: 擎朗智能科技是一家专注于室内无人配送机器人研发与应用的高科技企业，总部位于上海。公司核心产品为“擎朗送餐机器人”，广泛应用于餐厅、酒店、医院等场景，提供高效、稳定的智能服务解决方案。其代表产品如Geli系列机器人已实现大规模商业化落地，在行业内具有领先地位。

name: 斯坦德机器人
description: 斯坦德机器人是全球领先的工业智能移动机器人解决方案提供商和提供工业具身智能机器人解决方案的先驱。

name: 新潮传媒
description: 新潮传媒是中国社区媒体数字化平台的代表企业之一，专注于电梯媒体和社区场景广告投放，利用AI和大数据技术实现精准触达，服务于本地生活、快消、教育等多个行业客户，推动传统户外媒体向数字化转型。

name: 明灏科技
description: 明灏科技(北京)有限公司是一家以自主研发为核心，专注于先进医学视光技术开发和成果转化、医学视光产品精密制造和视光医疗信息化的国家级高新技术企业和专精特新企业。

name: 易久批
description: 易久批平台由易久批信息技术有限公司运营管理。易久批信息技术有限公司及其持股、控股企业从创立到现在走过了7个年头，已发展成为跨品类、跨区域、全产业链的快销品产业互联网企业集团，是中国新一代的互联网独角兽企业、国内领先的产业互联网平台。

name: 易点云
description: 易点云成立于2014年，是中国领先的IT办公设备租赁服务提供商，专注于为企业客户提供一站式IT设备全生命周期管理解决方案，涵盖电脑、打印机、服务器等设备的租赁、维护及回收服务。通过SaaS平台实现设备远程管理，助力企业降本增效，提升信息化管理水平。

name: 星猿哲科技
description: 星猿哲科技（XYZ Robotics）成立于 2018 年，总部位于上海，是一家专注于移动复合机器人和 3D 视觉产品研发，赋能全球物流和制造生产力升级。凭借前沿的感知和规划技术，星猿哲提供装卸车、拆码垛、无序抓取、装配等解决方案，覆盖医药、食品、烟酒、电商、汽车、新能源等行业。星猿哲获评国家级专精特新企业，累计完成 1 亿美元融资。

name: 星迈创新
description: 星迈创新（成立于2022年7月）是一家专注于泳池智能清洁机器人研发与创新的科技公司，以户外/泳池场景机器人化为主攻方向，品牌名为 Beatbot。公司拥有自主研发的如无刷水泵、SLAM 导航算法、浮力智能控制系统等核心技术，并在高端泳池机器人产品中占据市场领先地位。截至最新融资周期，公司已完成 A 轮融资，累计融资超过5亿元人民币，估值近20亿元人民币。

name: 星锐医药
description: 星锐医药(Starna Therapeutics) 成立于2021年8月，公司聚焦肝外靶向递送技术，致力于研发以RNA为核心的创新药物，解决未被满足的临床需求。

name: 昱言生物
description: 昱言生物（Foreseen Biotechnology / 昱言科技（北京）有限公司）是一家由蛋白质组学领域专家及具有国际大型药企经验的海归博士团队于 2021 年创立的生物技术创新企业。 公司基于前沿蛋白质组学平台，从临床未被满足的需求出发，设计人群队列，获取高质量、多维度的蛋白组学信息，并结合多组学分析，以加速生物标志物（biomarker）与创新药物靶点的发现。 在诊断方向，公司已启动第一个化学发光 IVD 产品注册，并和医院合作开展 LDT（实验室开发测试）的联合开发；在治疗方向，通过其 ADC 等项目（如 FS001）与国际合作伙伴达成许可或联合开发。 场景涉及肿瘤、炎症／自身免疫、神经系统等多个难治疾病领域。

name: 月之暗面
description: 月之暗面 (Moonshot AI) 创立于2023年3月，致力于寻求将能源转化为智能的最优解，打造全能新质生产力。现已推出支持深度思考、多模态推理、能够输入20万字长文本的智能助手产品 Kimi。

name: 柯泰亚生物
description: 柯泰亚生物是一家致力于通过合成生物技术，研发、生产和销售高附加值生物基产品，为食品营养、个人护理、医药等市场提供天然、绿色、高质量创新原料的合成生物公司。

name: 标果工厂
description: 成都标果科技有限公司（简称：标果工厂）创建于2020年初，创始人和联合创始人曾作为中国最大的干线物流互联网平台货车帮的CEO及天使投资人，深度参与了中国物流行业的升级，让中国干线物流的效率整体提升，该平台2021年在纽交所上市（满帮: US YMM）。经历5年创业，标果工厂成为中国互联网生鲜B2B公司中年规模领先且保持持续盈利能力的商业组织。截至2025年4月，已经在四川、江西、湖南、河南、广东、河北、陕西、浙江、贵州等9省开展业务，业务涉及水果、蔬菜、冻品、奶品等类别，员工超过1300人。

name: 梅卡曼德
description: 梅卡曼德机器人由清华海归团队于2016年创办，致力于推动具身智能机器人无所不在的存在。采用先进AI和传感技术，梅卡曼德打造出强大的机器人3D视觉眼睛、AI大脑及仿生五指灵巧手，具备高通用性、高标准化等特点。能快速适配各种机器人形态，赋予机器人精准感知、智能决策和高效执行的能力。让机器人走入千行百业、千家万户，适应更多复杂场景的多样化需求。

name: 橙氧科技
description: 上海橙氧科技成立于2018年，专注于电化学技术及设备研发，致力于低碳化学品现场生产。其核心产品为分布式双氧水发生系统，解决了传统双氧水生产的高污染、高碳排问题，已获全球纸业巨头采用。2022年完成数千万元A轮融资，由沃衍资本、盈德气体等投资，资金用于电化学碳减排技术研发及市场化拓展。公司还在开发氯碱电解槽、可逆空气电池等新型产品，推动化工行业绿色转型。

name: 橡鹿机器人
description: 橡鹿机器人是橡鹿科技旗下公司，是一家专注于提升餐饮供给质量的硬科技公司。聚焦Robot + Food战略方向，公司⾃主研发智能炒菜机器⼈美膳狮。美膳狮完美复现“⼤师级”厨师的烹饪手法与味道，提供机器人+菜谱程序+后厨智能管理系统的交付闭环模式，帮助餐饮商家实现规模化复制，帮助消费者吃上新鲜、现炒有锅气的食物。美膳狮已在餐饮、酒店、等多个场景运用，落地众多头部餐饮品牌，获得非团餐类智能炒菜机器人出货量第一，成为行业领导者。

name: 欣旺达电池
description: 欣旺达以“创新驱动新能源世界进步”为使命，深耕锂电池领域，致力于为社会提供更多绿色、快速、高效的新能源一体化解决方案。公司构建了3C消费类电池、动力电池、储能系统、智能硬件、创新与生态五大业务。在立足深圳、服务全球的愿景下，目前已在国内的广东、江苏、浙江、山东、江西、四川、湖北等省份，以及印度、越南、匈牙利、摩洛哥等国家布局多个生产制造基地，在美国、法国、德国、以色列、韩国、日本设立海外营销机构。

name: 每日黑巧
description: 每日黑巧是一家主打健康理念的巧克力品牌，以无糖黑巧切入市场，采用可可含量高的配方，倡导低糖、健康的饮食方式，受到注重营养和身材管理人群的喜爱。

name: 法奥机器人
description: 法奥机器人成立于2019年，在全球率先实现供应链创新，是一家全核心零部件自研自产的协作机器人公司。

name: 浙达能源
description: 国内领先的智慧能源、智能电网、电力交易、虚拟电厂、数字孪生技术产品服务提供商和集成运营商。

name: 海柔创新
description: 海柔创新是一家专注箱式仓储机器人系统的科技企业，致力于为全球企业提供高效、智能的仓储自动化解决方案。公司自主研发的库宝系统（HAIPICK）实现了物料搬运与存储的柔性化升级，在电商、制造、零售等多个行业广泛应用。

name: 深势科技
description: 深势科技是全球AI for Science领导者，依托在交叉学科领域的深耕，构建了“深势·宇知”AI for Science大模型体系，并进一步解决科学研究和工业研发领域的关键问题，将众多学科的科研方法从“实验试错 / 计算机”时代带入了“预训练模型时代”，形成了AI for Science的“创新-落地”链路和开放生态，赋能“千行百业”，为人类经济发展最基础的生物医药、能源、材料和信息科学与工程研究打造新一代工业设计与仿真系统。

name: 深度智控
description: 深度智控（南京深度智控科技有限公司）是一家行业领先的深度节能与数智化创新服务商，专注于研发新一代深度节能与物联智控前沿产品与技术，赋能工业与建筑节能行业。

name: 深纳普思
description: 深纳普思是一家专注于AI+医疗健康领域，通过医用级智能可穿戴设备和深度学习算法，为慢性病患者提供智能化、数字化的控病解决方案的公司。

name: 爱科农
description: 爱科农是一家专注于农业大数据、机器学习预测和农业物联网技术，为农业生产者提供智慧种植决策服务的高新技术企业。

name: 特纳飞
description: 特纳飞是一家提供固态硬盘控制器整体解决方案的创业公司，专注于Flash Based高速存储芯片、固件与系统设计开发。

name: 王小卤
description: 王小卤是北京王小卤网络科技有限公司旗下的零食品牌，成立于2016年，总部位于北京。作为虎皮凤爪品类的领军者，王小卤凭借川卤与酱卤技术结合，打造无添加剂卤味产品，主打虎皮凤爪单品连续多年稳居天猫鸡肉零食类目销量第一。

name: 理想汽车
description: 理想汽车成立于2015年，是一家中国新能源汽车制造商，专注于设计、研发、制造和销售豪华智能电动汽车。其首席执行官为创始人李想，总部位于北京，并在江苏常州设有自有生产基地。理想汽车致力于为家庭打造更安全、更便捷、更舒适的智能电动车，主要产品包括理想L9（全尺寸六座SUV）、理想L8（中大型六座SUV）、理想L7（中大型五座SUV）等。公司于纳斯达克（NASDAQ：LI）和港交所（2015）上市。

name: 百布
description: 百布是中国领先的纺织产业互联网平台，成立于2014年，专注于为服装企业提供从面料采购、供应链管理到智能制造的一站式解决方案。公司通过数字化手段重构传统纺织产业链，提升交易效率与生产协同能力。

name: 百果园
description: 百果园（全称深圳百果园实业（集团）股份有限公司），2001年成立于深圳，是一家集水果采购、种植支持、采后保鲜、物流仓储、标准分级、营销拓展、品牌运营、门店零售、信息科技、金融资本、科研教育于一体的大型连锁企业。

name: 矽行半导体
description: 矽行公司成立于2021年11月，由科创板首批上市公司天准科技及其核心管理团队合资创立，总部位于苏州。公司核心团队汇聚了来自国内外知名半导体设备公司、晶圆代工厂、上市公司和研究机构的顶尖人才，专注于高端晶圆缺陷检测设备及零部件的研发、生产和销售。矽行依托卓越的人才团队和合作伙伴，运用最先进的人工智能技术和超高精密的光机电技术，促进半导体制程的工艺改善和良率提升，帮助下游客户实现更高质量、更高效率、更大价值。矽行致力于成为全球领先的半导体光学检测设备公司，持续推动行业的进步。

name: 硅基仿生
description: 深圳硅基仿生科技有限公司是一家致力于医用有源植入和医疗人工智能研发与产业化的公司。公司总部位于深圳。此外，公司在美国洛杉矶、北京和广州设有分部。

name: 祥邦科技
description: 祥邦科技（浙江祥邦科技股份有限公司）是国内封装胶膜领域的领导型企业之一，致力于研发、生产和销售光伏组件用封装胶膜，产品以POE光伏胶膜为主，同时覆盖EPE、白膜、EVA等全系列，并向客户提供定制化胶膜产品。公司目前拥有华中和华东两大生产基地，正在积极筹建海外生产基地以及国内第三处生产基地。

name: 美克生能源
description: 上海美克生能源科技有限公司成立于2018年，是一家面向新型电力系统的分布式绿色能源聚合服务商。在国家“双碳”战略指导下，公司聚焦AI储能调节运营，面向市场提供能源资产的投资建设、安全运维、聚合增值等多元化新型能源科技服务，全面助力千行百业实现绿色低碳转型。

name: 美团
description: 美团（港交所代码：3690.HK）是中国领先的生活服务电子商务平台，提供外卖、到店、酒旅、出行等多种本地生活服务，致力于用科技连接人与服务，提升城市生活的便利性与效率。

name: 联盛新能源
description: 联盛新能源集团，成立于2009年，是中国领先的清洁能源综合服务商，主营业务涵盖光伏发电、风能发电、储能系统集成以及能源互联网解决方案，致力于为企业和政府提供绿色电力支持，推动碳中和目标实现 。公司项目遍布全国多个省市，并积极拓展海外市场。

name: 聚芯微电子
description: 武汉聚芯微电子有限责任公司，成立于2016年，专注于高性能模拟与混合信号集成电路的研发与销售，主要产品包括电源管理芯片、音频功放芯片等，广泛应用于消费电子、工业控制和汽车电子领域。公司已获得多项核心技术专利，并与国内外多家知名企业建立合作关系。

name: 腾希航空科技
description: 腾希航空（厦门腾希航空科技有限公司）是一家专业从事电动垂直起降飞行器（eVTOL）、无人自转旋翼机的研发、生产与服务的高科技企业，致力于成为城市空中交通服务的全球领航者。

name: 自如
description: 自如是中国领先的长租公寓品牌和服务平台，隶属于链家集团，成立于2011年。自如提供从房屋租赁、装修、托管到租后服务的一站式居住解决方案，覆盖全国多个城市，致力于为年轻用户提供高品质、便捷的居住体验。

name: 致德新能源
description: 一家专注于锂电池用高容量硅负极材料研发、生产及销售的初创公司。

name: 英得尔
description: 英得尔成立于2005年6月，专注研发与生产车载冰箱，是一家行业领先面向全球的专业制造商。首期园区占地面积88亩，建筑面积超10万平方米，拥有行业领先的专业实验室及智能生产线。总部位于广东中山，分别在上海、佛山、香港、英国、美国等国家或地区设立分部，拓展全球业务。公司分为前装定制、零售品牌、ODM三大板块业务。

name: 茶颜悦色
description: 茶颜悦色是中国知名的现制茶饮品牌，起源于湖南长沙，以中国风的品牌设计和特色茶饮产品著称，深受年轻消费者喜爱，是新式茶饮行业的代表性品牌之一。

name: 视涯科技
description: 视涯科技股份有限公司（简称“视涯科技”）创立于2016年10月，是一家专业从事新一代半导体OLEDoS显示器研发、设计、生产和销售的高科技企业。视涯科技致力于打造OLEDoS显示应用生态链，为客户提供端到端微显示相关解决方案。

name: 贝壳找房
description: 贝壳找房是中国领先的房产交易与服务平台，致力于构建“技术驱动的品质居住服务生态”。公司以“科技+服务”为核心，提供新房、二手房、租房等全方位房产信息服务，并通过VR看房、智能找房等技术创新提升用户体验。

name: 赛桥生物
description: 赛桥生物是一家CGT智能制造解决方案提供商，专注于CGT行业上游关键制造技术及成套核心工艺装备的源头技术创新和国产化工作，致力于实现CGT产业化装备的全封闭、自动化、数字化和柔性化。

name: 赛纳生物
description: 赛纳生物科技（北京）有限公司是一家集基因技术研发、成果转化、生产与营销于一体的国家高新技术企业，公司总部位于北京亦庄经济开发区。 成立团队包括谢晓亮院士、黄岩谊教授、陈子天博士等科学家，以荧光发生测序技术和纠错编码测序技术为核心技术，强调从技术源头创新以提升测序准确性和成本效率。 赛纳生物为生命科学研究和基因诊断提供核心测序设备，同时在肿瘤、病原微生物、生殖健康、环境与食品安全等领域推出快速、准确、简便的解决方案。 公司产品与服务涵盖测序仪器、试剂以及分析软件等，是国产化基因测序生态的一部分。

name: 运去哪
description: 上海汇航捷讯网络科技有限公司（运去哪）是国内首家国际物流电商交易平台，总部位于上海。公司致力于为全球货主和货代提供一站式国际物流服务，涵盖在线运价查询、订舱、支付、订单追踪等环节，通过引入电商模式大幅提升行业的透明度与运作效率。运去哪拥有覆盖北美、拉美、东南亚等重点区域的分支机构，链接超过300家船公司与航空公司，整合3500+优质供应商资源，形成强大的生态网络。同时，公司组建了超过500人的专业客服与履约团队，全程保障客户货物运输的安全与顺畅。凭借技术驱动与服务创新，运去哪正推动传统国际物流向数字化、智能化转型，成为连接中国与全球市场的重要桥梁。

name: 邻几
description: 邻几便利店是总部位于合肥的连锁零售品牌，致力于打造社区型便利生活空间，提供多样化的日常消费品及便捷服务，覆盖城市居民日常生活需求。

name: 银河航天
description: 银河航天是我国领先的卫星互联网解决方案提供商和卫星制造商，是我国商业航天领域第一家独角兽公司。公司致力于通信载荷、核心单机、卫星平台的自主研发与低成本量产，在西安、成都和北京分别构建了国际领先水平的通信载荷、核心单机和太阳翼的配套研制能力，并在南通建设新一代卫星智能制造工厂，已实现百颗卫星的量产能力。

name: 银河通用机器人
description: 银河通用机器人是一家引领行业前沿的具身多模态大模型通用机器人创新企业，专注具身智能服务机器人，覆盖工业、家庭场景。团队来自顶尖机构，致力于通用机器人研发，推动智能服务落地。

name: 锐锢商城

name: zephr
description: Zephr uses an ensemble optimization model that collectively harnesses errors from all mobile devices in the network. Before Zephr, the accuracy and error for each GPS data point was unique to its location solution. A networked solution not only improves each phone’s individual location solution, but also makes the network of data collected more accurate. The measurements made by networked devices have a consistent absolute accuracy observed independently. Users share their GPS errors with Zephr and, in return, they receive an optimized location solution to their mobile device. This means that Zephr does not need to transmit users location data helping ensure privacy for their customers.

name: Kall Morris Incorporated

grants.name: USSF SpaceWERX Orbital Prime STTR Phase I (3 awards)
SpaceWERX STTR Phase II - REACCH in-space grappling
SpaceWERX STTR Phase II - Asteria secondary payload attachments
Department of the Air Force Direct-to-Phase II SBIR - Laelaps spacecraft

funding_notes: Verified domain kallmorris.com; Kall Morris Inc (KMI), Marquette, Michigan, founded 2019, works on space-debris removal and relocation (REACCH grappler, Laelaps spacecraft; REACCH flew to the ISS on SpaceX CRS-31 in Nov 2024). In Nov 2023 KMI announced $5M in combined funding. Payload breaks this down as about $4.25M in SpaceWERX/AFWERX STTR/SBIR Phase II awards plus $750,000 from a closed pre-seed and seed round. Michigan Rise Pre-Seed Fund III led the pre-seed (first invested in 2021), and MSU Research Foundation's Red Cedar Ventures is also a backer. SEC Form D filings show the private money was raised through non-priced instruments: about $258K of debt-type securities (Jul 2021) and SAFEs of $215K (Mar 2023), $180K (Jul 2023) and $140K (Dec 2024), roughly $793K in total. The 'seed' was SAFE-based with no public priced seed round, so status is pre-seed/angel-only. amount_raised uses the company-reported $750K. Grants listed are SBIR/STTR (non-dilutive), and KMI also cites a partnered NASA SBIR Phase II.

Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 builds security culture and helps teams manage both human and agent risk. The company delivers a comprehensive, agentic best-of-suite platform for Human Risk Management, creating an adaptive defense layer that reinforces secure behavior against evolving cybersecurity threats. The HRM+ platform includes awareness training, integrated cloud email security, real-time coaching, crowdsourced anti-phishing, AI Defense Agents, and more.

name: NetSPI
description: NetSPI is the leader in enterprise security testing and attack surface management, partnering with nine of the top 10 U.S. banks, three of the world’s five largest health care companies, the largest global cloud providers, and many of the Fortune® 500. NetSPI experts perform deep dive manual penetration testing of application, network, and cloud attack surfaces, historically testing over 1 million assets to find 4 million unique vulnerabilities. NetSPI offers Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS) through its Resolve™ platform and adversary simulation through its Red Team Tool Kit.

Noetic improves security tool and control efficacy by breaking down existing siloes and improving the entire security ecosystem.

name: OffSec
description: OffSec is the leading provider of continuous professional and workforce development, training, and education for cybersecurity professionals. Created by the community for the community, OffSec’s one-of-a-kind mix of practical, hands-on training and certification programs, virtual labs, and open-source projects provide practitioners with the highly desired offensive skills to get a job, advance their careers and better protect their organizations. OffSec is committed to funding and growing Kali Linux, the leading operating system for penetration testing, ethical hacking, and network security assessments. For more information, visitoffsec.comand follow@OffSectrainingand ourBlog.

name: Ontic
description: Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations.

description: Red Access is ushering in the next generation of secure browsing solutions with the first session-based, agentless security platform, capable of securing any browser. name: ReliaQuest
description: ReliaQuest is a cybersecurity company that helps organizations detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats across complex IT environments. Through its GreyMatter platform, ReliaQuest integrates data from existing security tools, providing unified visibility, advanced threat detection, and automated response capabilities.

name: Revelock
description: Revelock enables financial services and fintech companies to reveal and respond to online identity impersonation & manipulation attacks without hindering the customer experience. Protecting more than 50 million banking customers worldwide, the Revelock Fraud Detection & Response (FDR) Platform combines behavioral biometrics, network and device assessment with hybrid AI and Deep Learning to create a BionicID™ and continuously Know Your User (KYU), spot bad actors and mitigate risk regardless of the type of attack.

name: Rig Security
description: Rig Security delivers unified protection across human, machine, and AI identities, with context driven coverage across cloud, on premises, and endpoints. Powered by an AI and ML correlation engine, Rig uncovers hidden, chained identity risks and threats, accelerates investigations by up to 95%, and provides identity first runtime policy enforcement that distinguishes AI agent activity from the human or machine identities those agents operate through.

description: RiPSIM Technologies has developed and patented the world’s first end-to-end eSIM-aaS management platform. This digital identity authentication platform enables wireless service providers of any size to design, develop and deliver eSIMs at any time, in any quantity, for any device and at the highest security level in the wireless industry. RiPSIM’s GSMA-certified, cloud-native, microservices-based software features highly intuitive and easy-to-use interfaces that allow users, regardless of skill level, to develop eSIMs with confidence. Now, wireless service providers can fully automate their eSIM workflows and reduce operational expenses.

name: Saviynt
description: Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI today. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies, and government institutions.

name: Semperis
description: Semperis is the identity-driven cyber resilience and crisis management company trusted by the world’s largest enterprises and government agencies to protect critical identity systems. Purpose-built for multi-cloud and hybrid identity environments—including Active Directory, Entra ID, and Okta—Semperis helps organizations prevent, detect, respond to, and recover from identity-based cyberattacks.

name: Silent Push
description: Silent Push is a preemptive cyber defense company. It is the first and only solution to provide a complete view of emerging threat infrastructure in real time, exposing malicious intent through its Indicators Of Future Attack™ (IOFA™) data, enabling security teams to proactively block hidden threats and avoid loss. The Silent Push standalone platform is also available via API, integrating with various security tools, including SIEM & XDR, SOAR, TIP, and OSINT, providing automated enrichment and actionable intelligence. Customers include some of the world’s largest enterprises within the Fortune 500 as well as government agencies.

name: Sonrai Security
description: Sonrai Security is a leading cloud privileged access management (PAM) solutions provider. With a mission to empower enterprises of all sizes to innovate securely and confidently, Sonrai Security delivers identity, access, and permissions security for companies running on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud platforms. The company is renowned for pioneering the Cloud Permissions Firewall, enabling one-click least privilege while supporting developer access needs without disruption.

name: Strivacity
description: Strivacity is an identity security company that helps brands build trusted relationships with customers, partners, and AI agents. Its single identity product secures access, protects privacy, and prevents fraud across human and automated interactions. Built on a single-instance architecture, Strivacity gives organizations strong control over data, compliance, and scale while enabling great digital experiences.

name: Twine
description: Twine is redefining cybersecurity operations with AI Digital Employees. Alex, the first digital employee, is an expert in Identity and Access Management, learning processes, executing identity tasks, and engaging directly with end users. By doing the work, not just flagging issues, Alex augments IAM teams and reduces operational workload by up to 70%.

name: Twistlock
description: Twistlock is the industry’s first enterprise security suite for virtual container security. The suite addresses risks on the host and within the application of the container, enabling enterprises to consistently enforce security policies, monitor and audit activity and identify and isolate threats in a container or cluster of containers.

name: Variance
description: Variance builds an agentic AI platform for fraud and abuse investigations, KYC/KYB and compliance operations. Variance combines context-aware reasoning, structured SOPs (policy-as-code), and governed AI agents that can take action with configurable oversight (approvals, audit trails, and role-based controls). The result is faster, more consistent decisions across high-volume, high-stakes workflows, without sacrificing accountability.

name: Vaultree
description: Vaultree is revolutionising data enablement and security through their pioneering Data-In-Use Encryption solutions. The industry-leading technology ensures that data remains encrypted throughout its entire lifecycle, enabling businesses with previously inhibited use cases and growth opportunities via products such as world-first Encrypted Data Sharing and Analysis as well as Encrypted Machine Learning. Vaultree’s solutions and approach to data enablement empower organisations to unlock and harness their data, driving compliant innovation while drastically reducing cyber threats.

name: Verodin
description: Verodin is the first business platform purpose-built to measure, manage, and improve security effectiveness through proactive testing. Its revolutionary Security Instrumentation Platform (SIP) empowers organizations to understand and communicate security effectiveness with quantifiable, evidence-based data. Through security instrumentation, Verodin users dramatically increase the ROI of their existing security investments, achieve maximum value from future spending and measurably mature their cyber prevention, detection and response effectiveness.

name: Vulcan
description: Vulcan Cyber provides a continuous vulnerability remediation solution. Vulcan integrates, automates and orchestrates existing tools and processes, eliminating the most critical risks caused by vulnerabilities while avoiding impact to business operations. Vulcan closes the vulnerability remediation gap, reducing exposure time from weeks and months to hours.

name: VulnCheck
description: VulnCheck is the exploit intelligence company helping enterprises, government organizations, and cybersecurity vendors solve the vulnerability prioritization challenge. Trusted by some of the world’s largest organizations responsible for protecting hundreds of millions of systems and people, VulnCheck helps organizations outpace adversaries by providing the most comprehensive, real-time vulnerability intelligence that is autonomously correlated with unique, proprietary exploit and threat intelligence.
